summary: The proposed patch changes the ForeignKey validation to use the base manager instead of the default manager. This resolves the issue of not being able to validate archived articles.

issues.description: This change may introduce a behavioral regression risk as it alters the default behavior of ForeignKey validation. Other parts of the application that rely on the default manager for validation might break.
The patch introduces a style inconsistency by changing the indentation of the line it modifies. It should follow the project's coding style conventions.
